title: UPPSC RO / ARO Recruitment 2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) , has released a Notification for the recruitment of Assistant Architect Planner, Sports Officer & Programmer Grade-2 Posts on its official website. This recruitment is being conducted for 25 vacancies. The UPPSC Application Form has started on 04 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 04 December 2026 . The Minimum age required is 21 Years & The Maximum Age Is 40 Years as on 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 which are given below. ( Advt No : A-5/E-1/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have proper knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script. They must possess a Degree in Architecture along with a Degree/Diploma in Town and Country Planning or Housing, or have 3 years of relevant experience in Architecture, Town Planning, or Housing. Alternatively, candidates with a 1-year Postgraduate Diploma in Housing and 1 year of relevant experience are also eligible. Additional desirable qualification includes experience in Housing, supported by an experience certificate issued by the Head of the Institution.
